I have successfully fixed the bug.

### Cause
In `binary_search`, the while loop condition was `lo < hi` instead of `lo <= hi`. When searching for the last element (where `lo` and `hi` both point to the last index), the loop would terminate before checking the final element, incorrectly returning `-1`.

### Fix
Changed `while lo < hi:` to `while lo <= hi:` in `search.py`.
